clock: process.hrtime.bigint, source fsync completed -> final local browser predicate and two animation frames after SDK completion; first-visible time retained separately.

edits.replacement: SelectedTeam is null ? "All catalog agents" : SelectedTeam.Name

sourceRestoration: Refuse concurrent file changes; byte-for-byte fsync undo, visible baseline and final SHA256.
css: Real isolated catalog CSS edit with the appropriate Tailwind companion in each lane; not a Tailwind-only compile benchmark.
oldProof: Historical 27 primary cycles untouched; this is a bounded attribution diagnostic, not a replacement benchmark.

environment.refresh: Explicit six lanes, on/off for each host; no launch profile may override suppression.

databaseReloadProtocol: When SDK browser reload displays the public Continue button, the local harness confirms the already verified isolated catalog fixture. Elapsed time includes reload, confirmation and resumed rendering; counts are reported. No operator database is allowed.
readiness: A single bounded readiness loop handles isolated database confirmation during both filter and clear. Require public search 40 -> 12 -> 40 and four stable seconds before timing. Warm reload confirmation remains included in edit-to-visible time.
sdkTiming: Record first visible state, separately capture SDK completion, then confirm final visible state before stopping the primary clock. Verify undo again after its SDK completion. No source undo occurs before completed SDK work.
